ideas.pitch: AI-powered satellite imagery monitoring platform to track illegal mining and industrial land encroachment specifically tailored for the state of Odisha's industrial corridors.
ideas.title: OdishaSat-Compliance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven high-scoring pattern of GeoNex-ATLAS by applying satellite monitoring to regional industrial compliance, which appeals strongly to judges looking for localized real-world impact in Eastern India.

ideas.pitch: AI-driven localized nutritional assistant that generates meal plans and macro breakdowns using traditional Eastern Indian dietary ingredients and regional cuisines.
ideas.title: ArogyaOS-Nutrition
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the winning health-tech architecture of E-Foodiee-AI-Nutrition-Assistant to a localized cultural context, making the utility immediately recognizable and compelling for judges.

ideas.pitch: Autonomous peer-to-peer energy trading platform for smart microgrids utilizing decentralized escrow mechanisms and predictive consumption forecasting.
ideas.title: Bhubaneswar-MicroGrid-Trade
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines robust forecasting mechanics with transaction flows similar to Dispatch and ClashX, targeting the Open 2nd Runners Up track with complex backend engineering.

ideas.pitch: Automated AML and financial anomaly detection platform built specifically for university student club treasuries and festival sponsorship funds.
ideas.title: DigiCampus-RiskEngine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mimics the graph intelligence and risk-scoring architecture of the DIGITIMES AI winner Bito, adapted for campus financial ecosystems which resonates well with NIT Rourkela organizers.

ideas.pitch: Multi-agent academic support system using LangGraph and localized RAG to help first-year engineering students navigate coursework and lab procedures.
ideas.title: EdiMent-AgenticMentor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the exact winning multi-agent architecture of the GreenNovation AI platform, targeting student-centric utility that directly solves onboarding pain points at technical institutes.
